text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since that last defeat, not a day 
has gone by where I haven't dreamed of 
that humiliation..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I trained all the harder so that I would 
never have to taste that bitterness 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. This "Empress" shall suffer no 
further defeat!
